speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Candidates have been briefed by their schools on the contingency plans to manage and cope with major train service disruptions during national examinations if they have them.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: On the examination personnel ‒ that means invigilator front ‒ they have also been briefed on the procedures to manage candidates who are late for examinations due to major train service disruptions.
